Original fantasy strategy adventure-map LARGE VEGETATION FORMATION SPRITE ATLAS, TRUE TRANSPARENT RGBA. Exactly 5 rows by 5 columns, 25 different isolated mass sprites. Painterly late-1990s pre-rendered strategy art, refined detailed foliage, elevated three-quarter view, upper-left lighting. Each sprite a MULTI-TILE contiguous woodland/wetland formation of many SMALL individual plants, 12-20 trees where applicable, with layered varied-height crowns and roots/undergrowth merging at the base. These must look like extensive landscape patches, NOT one gigantic tree, NOT three enormous trees. Irregular asymmetric alpha outline, spurs, concave bays, crooked extensions, scalloped canopy edge. NO square footprint, NO rectangular or circular ground platform, NO frame, NO tile-shaped water patch, NO labels/text/background. Sparse low edge shrubs and roots taper naturally into transparency. Five strongly different arrangements per row: col1 winding diagonal grove with a long low spur; col2 open crescent thicket with unequal arms; col3 branching woodland with off-center taller trees; col4 broad patchy grove with staggered heights and deeply indented edges; col5 crooked elongated woodland wall with a long tapering tail. Independently change silhouette/proportions between rows, avoid identical recolors. Every sprite wholly inside its own equal-sized cell with 20px completely TRANSPARENT gutters, NO touching adjacent cells. Muted natural palette matching terrain, readable at 150 pixels. Original designs, no copied game pixels.
Exactly these habitats by row: Row1 patchy grassland oak and birch groves, warm olive green leaves and light trunks, several low clearings between canopy lobes. Row2 dense deep forest of many small broadleaf trees, darker green layered foliage, fern understory. Row3 rugged highland pine and spruce stands, blue-green needles, modest lichen ground cover. Row4 snow-frost evergreen stands, irregular pointed small trees, lightly snow-dusted boughs, snow only along roots no square floor. Row5 windswept coastal woodland, bent small broadleaf trees, sandy roots, subdued sage and olive foliage.
